races.name: Aquatic Dwarf
races.traits: Darkvision 60 ft. Stonecunning. Stability: +4 against bull rush and trip while standing on the ground. Weapon familiarity: dwarven waraxe and urgrosh. Speed 20 ft, never reduced by armor or load. Aquatic subtype: breathes water, and air only if also amphibious. A swim speed, with +8 on Swim checks and always able to take 10 on them. Swim 20 ft.

races.name: Aquatic Elf
races.traits: Immune to magic sleep effects. Low-light vision. Proficient with longsword, rapier, longbow and shortbow. Notices a secret door on passing within 5 ft, with a Search check. Aquatic subtype: breathes water, and air only if also amphibious. A swim speed, with +8 on Swim checks and always able to take 10 on them. Swim 40 ft. No gills.

races.name: Aquatic Gnome
races.traits: Low-light vision. Weapon familiarity: gnome hooked hammer. Illusions you cast have a save DC 1 higher. Speak with animals 1/day, and dancing lights, ghost sound and prestidigitation 1/day with Charisma 10 or better. Aquatic subtype: breathes water, and air only if also amphibious. A swim speed, with +8 on Swim checks and always able to take 10 on them. Swim 20 ft.

races.name: Aquatic Half-Elf
races.traits: Immune to magic sleep effects. Low-light vision. Elven blood: counts as an elf for anything that cares. Aquatic subtype: breathes water, and air only if also amphibious. A swim speed, with +8 on Swim checks and always able to take 10 on them. Swim 40 ft.

races.name: Aquatic Half-Orc
races.traits: Darkvision 60 ft. Orc blood: counts as an orc for anything that cares. Aquatic subtype: breathes water, and air only if also amphibious. A swim speed, with +8 on Swim checks and always able to take 10 on them. Swim 30 ft.

races.name: Aquatic Halfling
races.traits: +1 on all saving throws, and a further +2 morale bonus against fear. Weapon familiarity: halflings treat the sling as a simple weapon in every way that matters to them. Aquatic subtype: breathes water, and air only if also amphibious. A swim speed, with +8 on Swim checks and always able to take 10 on them. Swim 20 ft. Low-light vision, seeing four times as far as a human.

races.traits: Bonus feat at 1st level. Four extra skill points at 1st level and one per level after. Favored class: any. Aquatic subtype: breathes water, and air only if also amphibious. classes.name: Prestige Bard

table.special: Bardic music (countersong, fascinate, inspire courage +1), bardic knowledge

classes.requires: Any nonlawful alignment; base attack bonus +3; Knowledge (any) 4 ranks and Perform (any) 8 ranks; able to cast 1st-level arcane spells of divination, enchantment and illusion.
classes.note: The bard as a prestige class. Its spellcasting adds to a arcane spellcasting class the character already has.

classes.name: Prestige Paladin

table.special: Detect evil, smite evil 1/day, turn undead
Divine grace, lay on hands, special mount

classes.requires: Lawful good; base attack bonus +4; Knowledge (religion) 2 ranks, Knowledge (nobility and royalty) 2 ranks and Ride 4 ranks; Mounted Combat; able to cast protection from evil as a divine spell; able to turn undead.
classes.note: The paladin as a prestige class. Its spellcasting adds to a divine spellcasting class the character already has.

classes.name: Prestige Ranger

table.special: 1st favored enemy, animal companion, wild empathy

classes.requires: Base attack bonus +4; Knowledge (nature) 2 ranks and Survival 4 ranks; Endurance, Track, and Rapid Shot or Two-Weapon Fighting; able to cast calm animals as a divine spell.
classes.note: The ranger as a prestige class. Its spellcasting adds to a divine spellcasting class the character already has.

feats.name: Accurate Jaunt
feats.prerequisite: Exposure to greater teleport, plane shift, teleport or shadow walk.
feats.benefit: Better odds of arriving where you mean to when teleporting or traveling between planes.

feats.name: Bladeproof Skin
feats.prerequisite: Exposure to stoneskin or iron body.
feats.benefit: Damage reduction 3/bludgeoning.

feats.name: Breadth of Knowledge
feats.prerequisite: Exposure to legend lore or vision.
feats.benefit: Every Knowledge check counts as trained.

feats.name: Conductivity
feats.prerequisite: Exposure to call lightning, lightning bolt or chain lightning.
feats.benefit: After taking electricity damage, loose a line of electricity at a target within 30 feet.

feats.name: Controlled Immolation
feats.prerequisite: Exposure to fireball or delayed blast fireball.
feats.benefit: No damage from catching fire, and creatures striking you in melee take 1d6 fire damage.

feats.name: Eyes to the Sky
feats.prerequisite: Exposure to scrying or greater scrying.
feats.benefit: You notice any magical scrying sensor within 40 feet.

feats.name: False Pretenses
feats.prerequisite: Exposure to a charm or dominate spell.
feats.benefit: You can make a caster believe you are charmed or dominated.

feats.name: Ineluctable Echo
feats.prerequisite: Exposure to wail of the banshee or any power word spell.
feats.benefit: A caster who targets you with a power word or wail of the banshee is caught by it too.

feats.name: Life Leech
feats.prerequisite: Exposure to the death touch granted power or death knell.
feats.benefit: Dying creatures within 30 feet lose a hit point, which you gain as temporary hit points.

feats.name: Live My Nightmare
feats.prerequisite: Exposure to phantasmal killer.
feats.benefit: A creature that targets you with divination suffers a nightmarish vision.

feats.name: Momentary Alteration
feats.prerequisite: Exposure to alter self.
feats.benefit: Alter self as a spell-like ability, for 1 minute, once a day.

feats.name: Naturalized Denizen
feats.prerequisite: Exposure to dimensional anchor.
feats.benefit: You are never treated as an extraplanar creature.

feats.name: Omniscient Whispers
feats.prerequisite: Exposure to commune or contact other plane.
feats.benefit: One question a week answered as though by commune.

feats.name: Photosynthetic Skin
feats.prerequisite: Exposure to barkskin.
feats.benefit: +2 natural armor while outdoors by day.

feats.name: Polar Chill
feats.prerequisite: Exposure to cone of cold or ice storm.
feats.benefit: Create a patch of icy ground that hampers movement.

feats.name: Residual Rebound
feats.prerequisite: Exposure to spell resistance or spell turning.
feats.benefit: A natural 20 on a save against a targeted spell turns it back on its caster.

feats.name: Stench of the Dead
feats.prerequisite: Exposure to ghoul touch or vampiric touch.
feats.benefit: A carrion stench sickens creatures next to you.

feats.name: Weapon Group (Axes)
feats.benefit: Proficient with handaxe, battleaxe, greataxe, dwarven waraxe (two-handed).

feats.name: Weapon Group (Basic Weapons)
feats.benefit: Proficient with club, dagger, quarterstaff.

feats.name: Weapon Group (Bows)
feats.benefit: Proficient with shortbow, longbow, composite shortbow, composite longbow.

feats.name: Weapon Group (Claw Weapons)
feats.benefit: Proficient with punching dagger, spiked gauntlet.

feats.name: Weapon Group (Crossbows)
feats.benefit: Proficient with heavy crossbow, light crossbow, repeating heavy crossbow, repeating light crossbow.

feats.name: Weapon Group (Druid Weapons)
feats.benefit: Proficient with club, dagger, dart, quarterstaff, scimitar, sickle, shortspear, sling, spear.

feats.name: Weapon Group (Flails and Chains)
feats.benefit: Proficient with light flail, heavy flail.

feats.name: Weapon Group (Heavy Blades)
feats.benefit: Proficient with longsword, greatsword, falchion, scimitar, bastard sword (two-handed).

feats.name: Weapon Group (Light Blades)
feats.benefit: Proficient with dagger, punching dagger, rapier, short sword.

feats.name: Weapon Group (Maces and Clubs)
feats.benefit: Proficient with club, light mace, heavy mace, greatclub, quarterstaff, sap.

feats.name: Weapon Group (Monk Weapons)
feats.benefit: Proficient with kama, nunchaku, quarterstaff, sai, shuriken, siangham.
feats.prerequisite: Improved Unarmed Strike.

feats.name: Weapon Group (Picks and Hammers)
feats.benefit: Proficient with light pick, heavy pick, light hammer, warhammer, scythe.

feats.name: Weapon Group (Polearms)
feats.benefit: Proficient with glaive, guisarme, halberd, ranseur.

feats.name: Weapon Group (Slings and Thrown Weapons)
feats.benefit: Proficient with dart, sling.

feats.name: Weapon Group (Spears and Lances)
feats.benefit: Proficient with javelin, lance, longspear, shortspear, trident.

feats.name: Weapon Group (Exotic Weapons)
feats.prerequisite: Base attack bonus +1.
feats.benefit: Proficient with the exotic weapons of every weapon group you know, and of each group you learn later.

feats.name: Weapon Group (Exotic Double Weapons)
feats.prerequisite: Base attack bonus +1.
feats.benefit: Proficient with the exotic double weapons of every weapon group you know, and of each group you learn later.

Wizard.name: Resistance to energy
Wizard.note: Once a day, grant a touched creature resistance to one energy type.

Wizard.name: Aura of protection
Wizard.note: Once a day, a deflection bonus to AC and resistance bonus on saves equal to Intelligence modifier.

Wizard.name: Spontaneous dispelling
Wizard.note: Give up prepared spells to cast dispel magic, and later greater dispel magic.

Wizard.name: Rapid summoning
Wizard.note: Summon monster spells take a standard action to cast.

Wizard.name: Enhanced summoning
Wizard.note: Augmented Summoning in place of Scribe Scroll, and summoned creatures that grow tougher with level.

Wizard.name: Spontaneous summoning
Wizard.note: Give up a prepared spell to cast a summon monster spell of a lower level.

Wizard.name: Enhanced awareness
Wizard.note: Sense Motive becomes a class skill, and some divinations work faster and harder to resist.

Wizard.name: Divination bonus feats
Wizard.note: Bonus feats from a list of perception feats in place of the usual ones.

Wizard.name: Prescience
Wizard.note: A daily pool of insight bonuses to add to d20 rolls.

Wizard.name: Cohort
Wizard.note: A loyal cohort in place of a familiar.

Wizard.name: Social proficiency
Wizard.note: Social skills as class skills, with bonuses that grow with level.

Wizard.name: Extended enchantment
Wizard.note: Enchantment spells last longer.

Wizard.name: Energy affinity
Wizard.note: Choose an energy type; evocations of it are stronger.

Wizard.name: Energy substitution
Wizard.note: Change an energy spell’s energy type as it is cast.

Wizard.name: Overcome resistance
Wizard.note: Energy spells ignore some of a target’s resistance.

Wizard.name: Chains of disbelief
Wizard.note: Illusions hold even after others are told they are false.

Wizard.name: Shadow shaper
Wizard.note: Hide becomes a class skill, and shadow powers come with level.

Wizard.name: Illusion mastery
Wizard.note: Two illusion spells added to the spellbook each level.

Wizard.name: Skeletal minion
Wizard.note: A skeleton servant that grows with level.

Wizard.name: Undead apotheosis
Wizard.note: Resistances like the undead’s, gained with level.

Wizard.name: Enhanced undead
Wizard.note: Undead you create are stronger.

Wizard.name: Enhance attribute
Wizard.note: A daily enhancement bonus to an ability score.

Wizard.name: Spell versatility
Wizard.note: Learn spells from prohibited schools as transmutations.

Wizard.name: Transmutable memory
Wizard.note: Once a day, swap prepared spells for others in the spellbook.

Druid.name: Aspect of nature
Druid.note: In place of wild shape: take on aspects of animals and elements, one more as the druid rises in level. Aspects: Agility (8th), Aquatic, Elemental air (16th), Elemental earth (16th), Elemental fire (16th), Elemental water (16th), Endurance (8th), Flight, Plant, Poison, Scent, Speed, Tooth and claw, Vigor (8th).
